messages:
alex_k: noticed a big LCP spike on the console map view after yesterday's frontend deploy. charts look fine, but the interactive map layer takes ~2-3s longer to paint in prod. anyone else seeing this?

maria: seeing it in eu-canary and a few prod traces. main-thread compile + parse high. stack points at main.bundle.js -> map vendor code.

kevin: hmm that smells like a bundle-split regression. map plugin used to be dynamic-imported, last refactor might have pulled it into the main chunk. can we confirm chunk sizes?

jess: yikes — i did change the import in PR #4123 because the dynamic import caused an edge-case hydration ordering bug. i switched to a static import to be safe. didn't realize bundle would blow up. @alex_k do you have a repro?

alex_k: repro with workspace X: open workspace map, enable 6+ layers, click toggle layer group -> on main thread you can see a ~120ms parse spike per layer and a big LCP jump. attaching a snippet from devtools timeline: `LongTask (parse/compile) main.bundle.js: 120ms`

deploy-bot: deploy 3501234000 by jess to canary finished at 3501234010.

maria: telemetry: about 35% of map render time is accounted for by telemetry serialization itself (we're sending full layer metadata each render). that plus the bigger bundle is killing the main thread.

sre_oncall: additional thing: KV tile cache keying includes user_id in the key which creates low cache locality for multi-tab users. switching to workspace_id would cut misses dramatically.

alex_k: short-term plan: revert static import -> dynamic import for map layers to split chunk, prune telemetry payloads, and lazy-load non-visible layers. can we do a quick canary rollback if needed? @jess

jess: i can push a rollback or small PR to restore dynamic import. can roll as a staged deploy 10%->50%->100% if QA looks ok.

kevin: sample PR fix (won't block on tests, tiny hotfix):
```
const MapLayers = await import(/* webpackChunkName: "map-layers" */ './map-layers');
const { renderLayers } = MapLayers;
```
Also add a separate vendor chunk for map libs: `splitChunks` rule for /map-libs/.

maria: i'll trim telemetry to `telemetry.send({event:'map.render', layer_count: layers.length, duration_ms})` and remove per-layer geometry until we have batching. reduces payload by ~70%.

sre_oncall: i'll change KV keying to `tile:${workspace_id}:${z}:${x}:${y}` and deploy as a traffic-safe change.

deploy-bot: rollback requested by jess for canary 3501234000 -> initiating 10% rollback at 3501234320.

jess: starting staged canary with dynamic import hotfix now. if no regressions in 15m i'll ramp. will post results. :thumbsup:

alex_k: thanks. long-term we should: 1) add an LCP alert on /workspace/*/map (threshold 2.5s), 2) add size-budgeting for chart/map vendor chunks, 3) include a quick checklist in PR template for import vs dynamic import tradeoffs.

kevin: agree on size budgets. i'll add a webpack analyzer job to CI that fails on >200kb map-vendor chunk.

maria: once hotfix is live i'll re-run the telemetry dashboard and post before/after numbers. initial expectation: LCP drop from ~3.2s -> ~1.8s in affected flows.

sre_oncall: posted the KV key PR, also setting a short-term cache-prefetch for common tiles to smooth first-load.

alex_k: perfect. i'll add a short postmortem summary in #postmortems after we verify. thanks all for the quick turnaround. :raised_hands:

jess: canary looks good at 10%, moving to 50% now (3501234560). will update when at 100%.

maria: initial telemetry from 10% canary: LCP down ~45% for the test cohort. payloads trimmed.

deploy-bot: canary ramp to 50% complete at 3501234620.

jess: ramped to 100% at 3501234720. monitoring for 30m.

alex_k: will keep the alert on for 24h and check for any fallout. great work.

kevin: follow-up items tracked in GH: #4220 (dynamic-import hotfix), #4221 (telemetry trim), #4222 (webpack budget), #4223 (kv-keying).

maria: i'll post before/after dashboard screenshots in this thread when i have them.

sre_oncall: leaving a note: consider a periodic job to recompute tile prefetch list to keep cold starts cheap.

alex_k: ack. closing loop after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
